La lukasa la plus secrète a disparu. Vot: The most secret lukasa has disappeared. So has your wish to revise, but nobody mourns that one.
Thémistocle rêvait d'oublier. Vous y arr: Themistocles dreamed of forgetting. You manage it without a teacher. I'm still billing you for the lesson.
Thamus avait prévu les gens qui ont l'ai: Thamus foresaw people who look learned. He didn't know you, and yet.
Ricci rangeait des caractères chinois da: Ricci stored Chinese characters in imaginary rooms. You leave your keys anywhere.
Pline a compilé vingt mille faits. Vous: Pliny compiled twenty thousand facts. You remembered two, one of them wrong.
Hugh followed his uncle's advice. You don't even follow mine.
On a prêté à Lulle des livres qu'il n'a: Llull was credited with books he did not write. You are credited with revision you did not do.
Un code civil entier à dix ans. Vous, à: A whole civil code at ten. At your age, you forget your password.
Hérigone jugeait les méthodes des autres: Hérigone judged other people's methods. So do I. Yours fails.
Ebbinghaus a mis votre oubli en équation: Ebbinghaus put your forgetting into an equation. One constant was missing: your bad faith.
Mace doublait les intervalles. Vous doub: Mace doubled the intervals. You double the excuses.
Fils de libraire et pas besoin de livres: A bookseller's son who needed no books. You would need a library, and a librarian.
Deux mille quatre cents tranches pour co: Two thousand four hundred slices to understand a brain. For yours, one would do.
Miller a rangé tous les mots anglais. Vo: Miller sorted every English word. You don't even sort your passwords.
Baddeley a ajouté un tampon à la mémoire: Baddeley added a buffer to memory. I'd gladly add a stamp to yours, in ink, on your forehead: "redo".
Gide a refusé Proust. Je refuse vos excu: Gide turned down Proust. I turn down your excuses. In both cases, history will judge.
James préférait la répétition active. Vo: James preferred active repetition. You practise active forgetting.
Bill Gates qui fait un coup de pied reto: Bill Gates doing a roundhouse kick. Your memory is doing the splits.
Les jeux de mémoire ne font gagner que 1: Memory games only gain you 11 words. My game makes you lose more.
Les dormeurs font moins d'erreurs. Vous: Sleepers make fewer mistakes. You make mistakes even asleep: I heard you.
Dix compétences retenues. Je note la dat: Ten skills retained. I'm noting the date: we'll see how many are left in a month.
Toute la branche jusqu'au rang 2. Simoni: The whole branch up to rank 2. Simonides lived to 90; at this rate, you'll need as long.
Trois sans-faute. Je vérifie que vous n': Three perfect scores. I'm checking you don't have a memory palace hidden under the table.
